hosting.name: Railway Free
hosting.price: $0/month plan with $1 resource credit per month
hosting.limits: 1 service replica, 0.5 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 1 GB ephemeral storage; sleep when idle
hosting.caveat: Only suitable for a light API and low traffic; monitor usage and suspend if credits run out

hosting.name: Vercel Hobby
hosting.role: Frontend hosting for personal/non-commercial prototype only
hosting.caveat: Official plan terms restrict Hobby to personal, non-commercial use. Do not host this business/agency frontend on Hobby; deploy to Vercel after an appropriate commercial plan is approved, or choose a compatible free commercial host.

database.name: Existing Supabase PostgreSQL project
database.caveat: Use the existing project; no second DB or paid add-on. Watch storage, egress and compute quotas.

database.name: Redis
database.license: RSALv2/SSPLv1 for current Redis; evaluate Valkey if needed
database.caveat: Not provisioned by default. PostgreSQL remains the source of truth; avoid extra service cost.

frontend.name: Next.js
frontend.role: Frontend framework and server-side API proxy

optional_ai.name: Groq API
optional_ai.price: Free developer tier with per-model RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD limits
optional_ai.caveat: Exact quotas depend on model and account. Never treat free limits as guaranteed capacity.

optional_ai.name: OpenRouter Free models
optional_ai.role: Fallback for prototyping and low-volume jobs
optional_ai.price: Free variants; usage currently capped at 50 requests/day and 20 requests/minute
optional_ai.caveat: Model availability and quotas can change; unsuitable as guaranteed production capacity.

optional_ai.name: Ollama
optional_ai.role: Self-hosted inference on a user's own compatible machine
optional_ai.price: Software is free; compute/hardware is not
optional_ai.caveat: Do not run large models on Railway Free 0.5 GB RAM.

media.name: Pexels API
media.price: Free API subject to provider limits and attribution rules
media.caveat: Check license and creator attribution for every downloaded asset; do not imply endorsement.

media.name: Whisper.cpp
media.caveat: Run on a capable user-owned machine; not enabled on Railway Free.

media.name: Piper
media.caveat: Check the individual voice/model license and commercial-use terms; local CPU/RAM needed.
